# What age should you claim Social Security?

> Free calculator for the best age to claim Social Security, for one person or a couple. Compares claiming at 62 to 70, shows break-even ages, and models spousal and survivor benefits under early death and long life. Runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
